name: Arcane
description: The headquarters is filled with magic of all kinds; its other tags and traits are often empowered by magical means.

name: Central Location
description: Located in a major metropolis with access to amenities and close to the action — but easy for others to reach too.

name: Contains Secrets
description: The place hides secrets the team can't easily solve or may be entirely unaware of.

name: Cozy
description: Relatively small — room for every member but not much more; people feel on top of each other.

name: Embedded Assistance
description: An embedded intelligence with its own name and personality controls the place and can exercise independent judgment.

name: High-Tech
description: Outfitted with all the latest technology, perhaps even tech beyond the cutting edge.

name: Interdimensional
description: Has easy access to more than one dimension — doors to other realms, times or universes.

name: Isolated Location
description: Isolated from the rest of the world — harder to reach, but less likely to be attacked. Should also have Transportation or Teleportation.

name: Low-Tech
description: Decidedly low-tech — old or purposefully rustic, and impervious to many tech-based attacks.

name: Mobile
description: Can move from place to place with ease; could double as the team's transportation.

name: Outside Funding
description: A person or organization outside the team paid for it — corporate, governmental or private — usually with strings attached.

name: Public Location
description: The location is widely known; those who need the team can find them, but so can villains.

name: Repurposed
description: Not originally designed as a headquarters, so it has a history that predates the team.

name: Roomy
description: Much larger than necessary, giving the team room to grow — but it can feel lonely.

name: Secret Location
description: The location is a tightly held secret; few outside the team and staff know where it is.

name: Shared
description: Shares its location with someone or something else, so the team doesn't have full control of it.

name: Staff
description: Comes with a staff that handles the team's needs — the classic example being Edwin Jarvis.

name: Stationary
description: Stays in a single place — the default for most headquarters.
